Source: https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii
Commit: 646b5d17135a2b2701ccc7a959afd0bbbf2f6160
Directory: externals/tz/tz

Horizon-compatible time-zone parser, derived from tzcode. Original copyright
and SPDX license notices are retained in each source file.

Local changes:
- Keep parsing scratch storage local to each call to allow concurrent requests.
- Reject a truncated TZif header before copying it.
- Validate serialized booleans as bytes before converting to bool.
